info.title: NTP_Association
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

address.description:
Reference Resource: [NTP_Association](#/NTP_Association)
FQDN or ip address for the association.

burst_mode.description: Type of burst mode to use (if any).

maxpoll.description: Maximum poll time in seconds expressed as a power of 2.

minpoll.description: Minimum poll time in seconds expressed as a power of 2.

ntp_version.description: NTP version to use for when communicating with this association.

prefer.description: Preference flag to suggest for this association. Set this to `true` to enable preference for this association.

ref_clock_id.description: The refclock driver ID, if available. A refclock driver ID like "127.127.1.0" for non uni/multi/broadcast associations

association_status.description: Key-value pairs that report NTP association status.

associd.description: Provides the Association ID mapped for this association. This is an Internal ID.

jitter.description: Provides jitter (in milliseconds) in the time reported for that remote peer or server.

last_polled.description: Provides information about when the peer was last polled. (in seconds ago OR 'h' hours ago OR 'd' days ago). Example 6h, 5d, 5 (this refers to seconds).

network_delay.description: Provides round trip delay (in milliseconds) between the switch and the remote peer or server.

peer_status_word.description: Provides information about the peer status. Refer to link for more info `https://www.eecis.udel.edu/~mills/ntp/html/decode.html#peer`

peer_type.description: Provides information about the remote peer type.

polling_interval.description: Provides the polling frequency (in seconds) used for this peer.

reachability_register.description: Provides status about the last consequetive polls for this peer. (1 bit per poll)

reference_time.description: Provides the time (in "day, month date year hh:mm" format) when the server clock of refid was last adjusted. Eg format Wed, Jan 13 2016  7:56:26.126

remote_peer_address.description: Provides the remote peer's ip address being synced to. If FQDN is used as "address" during config, then this would be the ip address.

remote_peer_ref_id.description: Provides the reference id used by the remote peer. This can be either another server or stratum 1 devices like .GPS. .USNO. etc. For more info, refer to `http://nlug.ml1.co.uk/2012/01/ntpq-p-output/831`

root_dispersion.description: Provides maximum error relative time (in seconds) to primary reference clock.

stratum.description: Provides the remote peer or server stratum level. Range between 1-16.

time_offset.description: Provides Root Mean Square time (in milliseconds) between this local host and the remote peer or server.

auto_prefer.description: Preference flag to suggest for this association. Set this to `true` to enable preference for this association. The value of this is not set by the user and will not be set if user sets a preferred server, this is assigned to a server to avoid toggling back and forth between primary servers

key_id.description:
Reference Resource: [NTP_Key](#/NTP_Key)
Key id is used if NTP client wants to connect to an authenticated association. Key id is not used when using an unauthenticated association.

origin.description: Indicates whether NTP server is obtained via DHCP or configured by user

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [NTP_Association](#/NTP_Association)
Specifies which VRF this association should connect with.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
